quarterly_data.signal: First half of FY March 2026 (April-September 2025): net sales JPY 87,209 million (down 12.1% year on year). Product revenue JPY 70,357 million (down 12.0%) bottomed in the first quarter and turned upward from the second quarter, but fell versus the prior first half mainly on lower demand for communications equipment in the Chinese market in Data Center & Networking; NRE revenue JPY 16,428 million (down 12.4%). Operating income JPY 3,767 million (down 75.8%) on a higher product cost ratio as relatively low-margin new products entered mass production and continued upfront development investment; ordinary income JPY 2,792 million (down 80.9%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 2,058 million (down 82.2%). Average exchange rate JPY 146.0 to the US dollar.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 87,209 million (-12.1%); product revenue JPY 70,357 million (-12.0%); NRE JPY 16,428 million (-12.4%); operating income JPY 3,767 million (-75.8%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management states development of the large design wins in Data Center & Networking, Automotive and Smart Devices is progressing smoothly, contributing to NRE revenue, with SoC mass production gradually starting and turning into product revenue. In the first half, operating cash flow was minus JPY 6,603 million as inventories rose JPY 11,186 million with the start of mass production of new products and receivables rose JPY 8,881 million; investment spending was JPY 6,049 million on property, plant and equipment (reticles, test boards and design environments for won design wins) and JPY 4,924 million on intangibles such as IP macros; R&D spending was JPY 28,956 million.
